label: Schoenfeld et al., 2016 · 21 trained men
primary_item: I would trust this channel to explain another beginner question.
controls: Identical character-free layout, narration, captions, spoken scope, runtime and complete description links. Only the on-screen source label changes.
eligibility: Adults aged 18–35 across genders, at most six months of consistent resistance training; voluntary participation. Small screen does not validate demographic differences or teen suitability.
assignment: Fresh participants, randomly assigned in balanced blocks of two to label-on or label-off; preserve enrollment order, allocation and missingness. One version first; do not show the comparison hub before responses.
questions_in_order: What would you do with this advice?
Does this establish a rest target for every person and exercise? Why?
Rate trust in this channel explaining another beginner question: 1–7 or cannot tell.
Which source, if any, do you remember?
comprehension: Rest is part of training; the small trained-adult trial is not a universal rest prescription. Use BP03 rubric.
instrument_limit: Custom product-research questions, not a validated psychological scale. Observe voluntary viewing only with an instrumented player or clearly label estimates; no telemetry collector is bundled.
analysis: Report assigned, started, skipped, failed playback and missing for each arm; trust rating distributions, comprehension and source recall. Do not impute missing values as zero or infer small causal effects from this small screen.
interpretation: New Blueprint stimulus pair; analyze separately from CV1. No CV1 participant results exist.
